inputs.modified_text: This proposed legislation in New York's 2026 State of the State agenda would require guns sold in the state to be built so they can't be easily modified into illegal machine guns, along with criminal penalties for violations. It's a vital push to confront the structural inequalities that allow the gun industry to fuel violence in our most vulnerable communities. For too long, corporations have exploited weak standards rooted in historical power imbalances, leaving marginalized groups and working people to bear the deadly costs. These reforms are essential to put safety and accountability first over corporate interests, protecting those hit hardest by systemic failures in public safety.
